hero.title: Every request raised, approved, printed and dispatched in one place.
hero.body: Your field team raises a request for an HCP, managers approve it, the vendor prints and dispatches it, and everyone follows it until it leaves the vendor. Wrappzo runs that whole workflow.

solutions.title: One workflow, from the field to dispatch
solutions.body: Each person sees and does only their part: the user raising the request, the managers approving it, the vendor printing and dispatching it.

request.title: Raise a request
request.description: Users pick a product from the PEL Store, or send a direct request, for one of their HCPs.
request.caption: Choose the HCP, the product and the quantity, and leave one note for the vendor.

doctors.title: HCP directory
doctors.description: Each user's HCPs in one list, with bulk upload for whole sheets at a time.
doctors.caption: Upload a sheet of HCPs once, then reuse them on every request.

approval.title: Manager approval
approval.description: Companies can require a manager to approve a request before it reaches the vendor.
approval.caption: Requests wait in the manager's queue until they decide.

artwork.title: Artwork review
artwork.description: The vendor's proof is reviewed by the MR, then up the reporting line, before anything is printed.
artwork.caption: A manager can approve in place of those below them when someone is unavailable.

vendors.title: Vendor fulfilment
vendors.description: Printers get their own portal for their orders, proof uploads and dispatch.
vendors.caption: Proofs are named PCode_Doctor_AM, so every file matches its order.

dispatch.title: Labels & dispatch
dispatch.description: Vendors download a dispatch label with the HCP's and the user's details.
dispatch.caption: Pack it, mark it dispatched, and the team sees it straight away.

tracking.title: Order tracking
tracking.description: Every order's status and history, from raised to dispatched.
tracking.caption: Follow an order without calling anyone.

dashboards.title: Team dashboards
dashboards.description: Managers see what is pending, approved and dispatched across their team.
dashboards.caption: Each person sees their own team's orders and nobody else's.

cta.title: Ready to see your requests through to dispatch?
cta.body: Log in to raise requests, approve artwork and track every order.

footer.blurb: Requests, approvals, printing and dispatch for field teams, run by Wrappzo.
footer.rights: © {{year}} Wrappzo. Operated by Orange Dot Solutions. All rights reserved.

steps.title: From request to dispatch in four steps
steps.body: Everyone sees only their part, and nothing moves on without the right person's go-ahead.

request.title: Request
request.description: A user picks the HCP, the product and the quantity.

approve.title: Approve
approve.description: A manager approves it, and later the artwork proof, before anything is printed.

print.title: Print
print.description: The vendor uploads the proof, prints the order and packs it.

dispatch.title: Dispatch
dispatch.description: The vendor dispatches the approved order with a label, and the team sees it straight away.

roles.title: Made for everyone in the chain
